_doc: Client-asserted-identity archetype rules and the shared guard-name
contracts/identity-archetype-rules.md. Rules match code SHAPE only;
no identity value is ever captured into a finding (Principle III).

rules.title: Identity asserted from a client-controlled request channel with no credential
rules.description: The function reads identity from a client-controlled request header or cookie and dispatches without verifying any credential, signature, or token. The header is attacker-supplied, so the caller selects which account the handler acts as.
rules.recommendation: Verify a server-issued credential (signed token, session lookup with signature/expiry checks, mTLS) before dispatch; rebuild req.identity exclusively from the verification result.
